extension.summary: Dex Glass collection customiser and widget organiser
extension.description: Filters Dex Hub Continue Watching and lets Dex Glass users choose, order and remove Kaptain catalogues as native skin rows. Reads the installed Dex Hub group index at runtime, without redistributing its code or changing its settings.
extension.license: MIT (original Dex Glass bridge code only)
extension.disclaimer: Experimental. Needs the separately installed official Dex Hub add-on.
